records.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-oriented PIXEL ART animation sprite sheet for LogicWorld, a side-scrolling educational sci-fi sandbox. Create ONE ORIGINAL CYBORG EXPLORER character with a visible warm human face in strict right-facing profile, short dark hair, compact teal armor, graphite undersuit, mechanical forearm and lower legs, cream/silver armor highlights and tiny cyan reactor light. Friendly resourceful young adult, no guns, no borrowed franchise design. Entire sheet transparent RGBA, no backdrop, no floor/shadows, no labels, no grid lines, no borders. EXACT CANVAS 1024x2048 pixels, exact 8 columns by 8 rows, each cell128x256 pixels, representing a native32x64-pixel frame enlarged exactly4x nearest neighbor. Draw with deliberate crisp square4x4 pixel clusters, limited16-color palette: navy #20283B, slate #667487, teal #3D9C9A, cyan #52C9D9, cream #F2E6CB, copper #B87D4B, green #6DE09A, warm human skin tones. No smooth vector shapes, antialiasing, gradients, blur or glow. Character remains same design/proportions and right-facing profile in every frame. Feet aligned at each cell local y244 (logical61), bottom-center pivot x64(logical16), plenty of transparent cell margin. One full-body figure per cell, never crosses cells. Precisely64 animation poses, read left to right by row: ROW1 eight-frame subtle idle breathing loop; ROW2 eight-frame side-view run cycle with distinct alternating contact/pass poses; ROW3 eight-frame jump takeoff/ascent; ROW4 eight-frame controlled falling loop; ROW5 eight-frame landing crouch and recover; ROW6 eight-frame reaching/interacting with a terminal using mechanical hand; ROW7 eight-frame building motion with a small handheld engineering tool; ROW8 eight-frame brief hurt/recoil and recovery (no blood). No duplicate static poses pretending to animate. Upper-left light with2-3 value steps. Pixel-art silhouette readable at actual32x64 size. This is an animation atlas, not a character illustration or mockup.
